cover: Stay, fix or move: a WordPress worksheet

slides.title: Which updates are hard?
slides.body: List the plugins waiting on updates. Note which ones nobody dares run, and why.

slides.title: What's making pages slow?
slides.body: Find the cause first. If tuning plugins or caching fixes speed on a phone, you might not need to move.

slides.title: Can someone else run the theme?
slides.body: If only the original developer understands it, find out whether another developer could take it on.

slides.title: Keep the editor or replace it?
slides.body: Keeping WordPress for editing adds a build process. A new CMS means training staff and checking every page.

slides.title: Who runs what afterward?
slides.body: Contact forms, newsletter signups, media and analytics. Name who operates each one after the move.

slides.title: What happens to every URL?
slides.body: Record old URLs and destinations, 301-redirect any that change, and watch Search Console after launch.
